title: Metabolite Extraction and Analysis Pipeline
summary: This cluster describes a pipeline for metabolite extraction and analysis. Metabolite Extraction involves cell pellets, centrifugation, and produces supernatant, which is then used to obtain methanol. The extracted metabolites are analyzed using various techniques, including capillary electrophoresis mass spectrometry, gas chromatography mass spectrometry, and liquid chromatography mass spectrometry. Proteins are also analyzed using western blot analysis, which involves polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis and blotting onto a PVDF membrane. The supernatant is also used in metabolomics analysis, which employs various platforms, including LC-MS/MS.
